name: SSTFormal EulerFeedback
mathematical_scope: Conditional stretching bound on [0,T), without assuming endpoint T smoothness. The assumed material ODE and uniform integrated upper bound are NOT derived from Euler pressure or Ruban geometry.

inputs.T: finite positive time T; theorems quantify only t in [0,T)
inputs.Phi: integrated stretch primitive Phi(0)=0 and Phi_prime=sigma on (0,T), dimensionless
inputs.cap: Phi(t)<=C uniformly on material labels and t<T
inputs.A: continuous linear operator; Euler application requires proof A(t)=grad u(t,X(t,a))
inputs.flow_coverage: explicit hypothesis for Eulerian transfer, not proved
